opennyai_summary.final__decision:
The petitioner is permitted to file an application seeking discharge and bring it to the notice of the concerned Court all the developments that have taken place subsequent NC: 2026:KHC:12814 HC-KAR to the registration of a crime including the orders passed by the Karnataka State Administrative Tribunal.
4. The petitioner is reserved liberty to knock at the doors of this Court in the event the discharge would not be accepted by the concerned Court.
5. With the aforesaid observations, the petition stands disposed.
